## Households

Take the 30-day Sacred Attention challenge as a family — digital fasting rhythms, contemplative prayer, mindful use — and extend Module 12's lifestyle audit toward thriving: do our schedules and screens produce deeply valuable experiences or merely full ones? Choose one "less but better" substitution and keep it.
